name: young-cohorts-only
about: §4R L2: a young account — every cohort is younger than 28 days, so the sheet holds counts and no rates at all.

output.headline: On 2026-11-03, 1 campaign ran and delivered 3 leads at $25.00 each.
points: Regional Class A — Joliet was the only campaign active, spending $75.00 to generate 3,900 impressions, 48 clicks, and 3 leads at a click rate of 1.2%.
Month-to-date spend on Meta through 2026-11 sits at $225.00, with 28 days left in the month.
The 2026-10-19 cohort has 9 leads: 8 contacted, 4 qualified, 2 applied, 1 hired, and 0 lost — it is still young, so no rates yet.
The 2026-10-26 cohort has 14 leads: 10 contacted, 3 qualified, 1 applied, 0 hired, and 2 lost — also too young to judge rates.
Both cohorts are still moving, so watch them before drawing conclusions on funnel performance.
